testcase.name: all named integration fixtures actually exist at pinned revision
format legality is independent of serving as commander and unknown is fail closed
real mono multi and colorless commanders resolve their complete identities
hybrid requires both colors while colorless candidates fit a mono commander
invalid commanders and face aliases fail clearly
Goblin Bombardment retains its activation sacrifice and associated action
Viscera Seer retains its activation sacrifice and associated action
Phyrexian Tower retains its activation sacrifice and associated action
Village Rites retains its additional casting sacrifice
Bone Splinters retains its additional casting sacrifice
Victimize resolution sacrifice retains success gate and exact target prerequisites
Murder can mechanically affect our nontoken creatures but is rejected by policy
Tragic Slip enhances removal through morbid but is not a direct generator
symmetrical Fleshbag sacrifice is a policy rejection not a controller rejection
Blood Artist is not a direct generator or death-enhanced creature removal
Gravecrawler is not a direct generator or death-enhanced creature removal
generic predicates reject opponent and token only filters
query conjunction preserves correlated OR scope instead of matching unrelated alternatives
unsupported scope retains UNKNOWN with independently inspectable decisions
synthetic nested composite and condition keep paths and prerequisites
synthetic independent abilities cannot donate sacrifice costs to another action
synthetic unsupported native effect is retained with action evidence
unchanged removal in both conditional branches is not a positive enhancement
alternative face executable scripts are inspected without granting separate card eligibility
real damage is conditional and does not guarantee or qualify ordinary friendly-target death
full discovery uses eligible input and produces serializable inspectable evidence
synthetic token-only and opponent-only operations are rejected after actual extraction
synthetic death-gated enabling and resolution-payment removal are separate contributions
synthetic unrelated conditional draw does not enhance removal outside that branch
synthetic death-triggered opposing sacrifice is removal, not damage to a player
synthetic self-cast death discount applies only when this action has a removal effect
real Cyclopean Mummy exiling its already-dead self is not battlefield removal
synthetic attached death-event binding stays unknown without attachment constraints
